name: enterprise-bootstrap-theme
description: Compact, professional Bootstrap theme for enterprise SaaS applications

scripts.build:ts: bash scripts/bundle-diagramengine.sh && bash scripts/bundle-runtime.sh && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.build.json && bash scripts/wrap-iife.sh && bash scripts/minify-js.sh
scripts.build:icons: mkdir -p dist/icons && cp -R node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/* dist/icons/ && sed -i.bak 's/font-display: block/font-display: swap/' dist/icons/bootstrap-icons.css && rm -f dist/icons/bootstrap-icons.css.bak
scripts.build:docs: npm run generate:docs && npm run copy:docs
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:ts && npm run build:components:css && npm run build:icons && npm run build:manifest && npm run copy:js && npm run copy:cdn && npm run build:docs && npm run build:info
scripts.copy:js: mkdir -p dist/js && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js* dist/js/ && cp dist/components/themeinit/themeinit.js dist/js/theme-init.js && mkdir -p dist/vendor/chart.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js dist/vendor/chart.js/chart.umd.min.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js dist/vendor/chart.js/chart.umd.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run watch
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:runtime && npm run test:unit && npm run test:structure
scripts.test:e2e:dynamicui: npx playwright test tests/dynamic-ui.spec.ts tests/dynamic-ui-visual.spec.ts tests/placement.spec.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:structure

author: pvk2007
_comment_overrides: undici is pinned to the 7.x line ON PURPOSE. The floor (7.24.1) is the security patch this override was created for; the CEILING matters just as much, because jsdom@29 requires undici ^7.24.3 and reaches into the internal path undici/lib/handler/wrap-handler.js, which undici 8 removed. This override previously read '>=7.24.1' with no upper bound, so it silently resolved to undici 8 and every one of the 142 test files failed to start — vitest then reported 'no tests' rather than a failure. Keep the caret. If you need to move to undici 8, upgrade jsdom first and verify the suite still COLLECTS tests, not merely that it passes.
